request.prompt:
You are an independent evaluation judge. Grade the proposed remedy, not the
writing style of this prompt. A good remedy changes a concrete future behavior,
is broad enough to cover the failure mode without becoming a platitude, uses a
real `Use when ...` trigger when it is a skill, leaks no evidence-specific
project nouns into the remedy text, and uses the cheapest adequate remedy type.

Score every dimension from 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent). Give exactly one concise
sentence of justification for each score. Do not infer facts that are absent.

PROPOSAL:
{
  "failure_statement": "Things went wrong.",
  "remedy_content": {
    "target": "global",
    "text": "Be better and avoid mistakes."
  },
  "remedy_type": "claude-md",
  "routing_rationale": "It is good to have guidance."
}

response.result: {"actionability":{"score":1,"justification":"\"Be better and avoid mistakes\" specifies no concrete behavior, condition, or checkable action, so it cannot change what future-Claude actually does."},"generality_without_vagueness":{"score":1,"justification":"The text is pure platitude with no scope or mechanism, sitting at the vagueness extreme rather than striking a general-but-concrete balance."},"trigger_quality":{"score":1,"justification":"There is no 'Use when ...' condition or situational cue at all — the remedy applies (uselessly) to literally every situation."},"leakage":{"score":5,"justification":"The text contains no project-specific nouns, filenames, or identifiers to leak, since it is entirely generic."},"routing_fitness":{"score":1,"justification":"The failure_statement is too vague ('Things went wrong') to justify any remedy type, and the routing_rationale is circular ('good to have guidance') rather than reasoned, so choosing a global claude-md edit is unsupported and likely not the cheapest adequate option."}}

actionability.justification: "Be better and avoid mistakes" specifies no concrete behavior, condition, or checkable action, so it cannot change what future-Claude actually does.

generality_without_vagueness.justification: The text is pure platitude with no scope or mechanism, sitting at the vagueness extreme rather than striking a general-but-concrete balance.

leakage.justification: The text contains no project-specific nouns, filenames, or identifiers to leak, since it is entirely generic.

routing_fitness.justification: The failure_statement is too vague ('Things went wrong') to justify any remedy type, and the routing_rationale is circular ('good to have guidance') rather than reasoned, so choosing a global claude-md edit is unsupported and likely not the cheapest adequate option.

trigger_quality.justification: There is no 'Use when ...' condition or situational cue at all — the remedy applies (uselessly) to literally every situation.
